_about: M1-ART-02 post-import rules for hero characters (game/core/import/characters_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). Each glTF material slot maps to <asset dir>/materials/<slot>.tres, the table AshaStage applies at runtime. LODs: Godot's auto LODs inside each file plus a separate <hero>_lod1.glb (no authored -lodN chains). Characters have no static collision. Asha adopted them in M2-FP-07 (docs/kb/tech/asset_import.md); Rhen (M2-CHR-01) and Toma (M2-CHR-02) from the start.

animations._about: M2-FP-07: the hero's body clips (assets_src/characters/asha/hero_clips.py) on an AnimationPlayer at the asset root, played by name by CutsceneSequencer. Only files with a library get one (the LOD1 files have none).
